title: CPU Cooling Fan Design
summary: Designed and assembled a parametric CPU cooling fan in SolidWorks, focusing on accurate component modeling, assembly, and design for future engineering analysis
problem: Design a realistic CPU cooling fan assembly that can serve as a foundation for engineering analysis, optimization, and future manufacturing studies.
approach: Created a complete 3D model of the CPU cooling fan in SolidWorks, including individual components and assembly mates. The design follows a parametric approach, making it easy to modify dimensions and prepare the model for future CFD and structural analysis.
solution: Created a complete 3D model of the CPU cooling fan in SolidWorks, including individual components and assembly mates. The design follows a parametric approach, making it easy to modify dimensions and prepare the model for future CFD and structural analysis.
